title: WorkshopEvent
description: Canonical event envelope for a strategy_workshop_event row. Covers all event_type variants including version-link events. Private content is represented only by private_content_ref and redacted_summary; raw content never appears here.

sequence_no.description: Monotonically increasing event counter within the workshop. Unique per (workshop_id, sequence_no).

actor_type.description: Category of actor that produced this event.

actor_ref.description: Opaque reference to the specific actor (user_id or persona_id). Null for system-generated events.

event_type.description: Discriminator for the event payload shape. See per-type conditional schemas below.

private_content_ref.description: Opaque reference to encrypted private content in the PrivateContentStore. Present only for event_type=message when the actor submitted content. The reference does not encode tenant, user, workshop, or object-store path. Required together with redacted_summary and redaction_policy_version when event_type is message.

redacted_summary.description: BFF-generated redacted summary of the private content. Required when private_content_ref is set. Never contains raw content.

redaction_policy_version.description: Version identifier for the redaction policy applied. Required when private_content_ref is set.

version_link.description: Populated for event_type in {version_created, version_selected}. Records which Registry version was linked or selected.

workshop_version_id.description: ID of the WorkshopVersionLink created or selected by this event.

strategy_id.description: Stable strategy identity resolved from the Registry record.

strategy_spec_registry_id.description: Immutable Registry version ID that this link points to. The StrategySpec document lives in the Registry; it is not copied here.

parent_workshop_version_id.description: Previous WorkshopVersionLink in this workshop, or null for the first version.

sequence_no.description: Version sequence counter within the workshop.

conclude_refs.description: Populated for event_type=concluded. Records the final strategy reference pointers. Conclude does NOT promote the StrategySpec lifecycle; Registry/governance transitions remain the Strategy Registry's responsibility.

final_workshop_version_id.description: The WorkshopVersionLink representing the final accepted Registry version.

final_strategy_spec_registry_id.description: The immutable Registry version ID at conclusion. Stored as a reference only.

status_change.description: Populated for event_type=status_changed. Records the lifecycle transition.

audit_reason.description: Required when reopening (in_review → open). Must be supplied with the If-Match header on the mutation request.

payload_refs.description: Structured references to related objects (research plans, consultation requests, etc.). Never contains StrategySpec JSON.

trace_id.description: Distributed trace ID for correlating this event with BFF and upstream service spans.

request_id.description: Idempotent request ID from the inbound BFF request header.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this event was created.
